id./param/scenario/cs/a_110_cs_040.pack|cs_: "We have been waiting, Master Rab.
"Ah, you've made preparations. Well done, Princess.
"Oh, it's you...
"Everyone, step back. The requiem ritual is held only by the two of the Dundrasil royal house, so please come this way.
"You're called princess by the old man... Could you be...
"Quiet. The ritual is beginning.
"Now then, {var:1}. Follow my lead. Understood?
"When people die, they all return to the Great Tree of Life. Each leaf of that tree is said to be a soul. And yet...
"Those slain by monsters are said to wander this world with regrets. A ritual to save such souls is passed down here.
"Look... Drawn by the scent of the smoke, shining butterflies have come.
"We treat these butterflies as souls and send them to the Tree of Life. That is how we comfort the dead.
"Eleanor did not simply die. She made herself a decoy to save you and the Princess of Heliodor.
"Two irreplaceable lives were saved... Thank you, Eleanor...
"...Come to think of it, didn't Eleanor leave you something?
{var:1} handed Rab their mother's letter!
"Oh! Th-this is!
"I see. So that's how it was... Because of this letter, you went to King Carnelian...
"{var:1}. I put you through such hardship...
"But because of that, we could meet like this. It was surely Eleanor's guidance.
"...Forgive me. Please leave me alone for a while.
